description: This file defines the OA_Cache_DeliveryCacheManager class, which manages cache invalidation for banners, images, zones, websites, linking, trackers, channels, and system settings within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Cache_DeliveryCacheManager
classes.description: A class for advanced invalidating delivery cache functions, extending OA_Cache_DeliveryCacheCommon.

methods.name: invalidateBannerCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache related to a specific banner, including banner ad cache, image cache, and zone-linked ads cache.

methods.name: invalidateImageCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache for a specific creative image file.

methods.name: invalidateZoneCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache related to a specific zone, including zone info, linked ads, and publisher zones.

methods.name: invalidateWebsiteCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache for a website (publisher), typically when zones are managed.

methods.name: invalidateZonesLinkingCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache for zones affected by linking or unlinking to campaigns.

methods.name: invalidateTrackerCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache for a specific tracker.

methods.name: invalidateChannelCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache for a specific channel.

methods.name: invalidateSystemSettingsCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache related to system settings, including maintenance, time zones, and Google JavaScript parameters.
